subject: store/mockstore: Use `Expression.Eval` to replace `EvalWithInnerCtx` for mockstore (#48771)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its parent, focusing on expression/planner/store(mockstore). Changes consistently move mockstore coprocessor execution to evaluate expressions via `Expression.Eval(sctx, row)` by constructing a per-request `sessionctx.Context` (mock context + `StmtCtx` initialized from request flags/timezone), and update `PBToExpr/PBToExprs`/`NewDistAggFunc` signatures plus dist-agg eval context to carry the session context. No Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, concurrency, or session/StmtCtx handling issues found in the touched paths; later history shows broader follow-up refactors around expression evaluation contexts but no indication of a needed fix for this change.
